steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rate. Each incident count is divided by hours worked, then compared with the trend.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 incident record shows a personal identifier

findings.title: Incident record with a personal identifier
findings.fix: Remove the identifier before the report is shared

findings.title: Rate with no hours worked
findings.fix: Record the hours worked for the period

findings.title: Case with no definition
findings.fix: Use the definition of a recordable case

outcome.notChecked: Under-reporting that the records do not show.
